+++
title = "colophon"
description = "What this site runs on and what it does not: Zola, nginx, NixOS, Snowcore, Njalla, Monero. No JavaScript, no Cloudflare, no third parties; logs stay on my boxes."
template = "colophon.html"
+++
## Build

- Generator: [Zola](https://www.getzola.org/), pinned in [the flake](https://github.com/0x0lor1n/hisilome).
- Diagrams: [d2](https://d2lang.com/), inlined as SVG.
- Font: [Iosevka](https://typeof.net/Iosevka/), self-hosted.
- Radio: [liquidsoap](https://www.liquidsoap.info/) and [icecast](https://icecast.org/). Now-playing is SSI ([how](/zero-js-radio/)).

## Serve

- OS: NixOS with [impermanence on btrfs](https://github.com/0x0lor1n/the-hive/blob/main/cells/server/profiles/storage-btrfs-rollback.nix).
- Web: nginx, HTTP/3, TLS 1.3.

- No cookies, no third party data collectors.
